title: Yellowed Juicy Turkish Spaghetti Icli Kofte
description: A rich and festive Turkish dish featuring spaghetti and juicy kofte, low in sodium and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente, then set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, bulgur, parsley, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small kofte and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the kofte and gently roll them to coat evenly.
Poach the kofte in simmering water for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a large serving dish, combine the cooked spaghetti and kofte, and toss to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
